method: Observed in-app browser walkthrough, backed by persisted run and export events. Not an automated browser test suite.
observations: Created a controlled variation through the interface, checked five required method fields, locked it and ran it successfully
Recorded a scientific review; it remained visible after refresh
Selected analysis, execution and tab remained selected after reload
Viewed the verified Law page-8 figure overlay; Escape closed the viewer and restored focus to Open paper
At a 390 by 844 viewport, Overview and Results had no document-level horizontal overflow (375 CSS pixels content width); closed navigation was hidden from keyboard focus
At a 1440 by 1000 viewport, reference and regenerated figures were readable side by side with no document-level overflow (1425 CSS pixels content width)
Variation dialog took focus and returned focus to Create variation on Escape
Submitted a fresh reference execution after restarting the API and worker; it succeeded and exposed sealed inputs.tar
Clicked Export reproducibility bundle for the fresh run; the server persisted the export event and the interface displayed no error
limitations: No live OIDC tenant or model provider was exercised
Imported PDF storage and workspace boundaries were verified by API tests; no browser file-picker test was performed
